# Chute, phase 2: materials (Paper 8, exact), the funnel opened at the top (two-sided in the bake
# so its inside shows), the sign's cream ring and centre inset on its front face, the sack's
# buried bottom removed, flat shading, export. Generated by make_chute.py.
material new Wood --base-color 0.3961 0.2510 0.3255 --no-slot
material new Rim --base-color 0.8196 0.6510 0.4941 --no-slot
material new Sack --base-color 0.8196 0.6510 0.4941 --no-slot
material new Cord --base-color 0.3961 0.2510 0.3255 --no-slot
material new Sign --base-color 0.6588 0.3765 0.3647 --no-slot
material new Ring --base-color 0.9647 0.9059 0.6118 --no-slot
select Leg0 Leg1 Leg2 Leg3 Hopper Post
material assign Wood
select RimF RimB RimL RimR
material assign Rim
select Sack Frill
material assign Sack
select Tie
material assign Cord
select Hopper
active Hopper
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Leg0
active Leg0
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Leg1
active Leg1
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Leg2
active Leg2
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Leg3
active Leg3
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Disc
active Disc
material assign Sign
mode edit
select face where "normal.y < -0.9"
material assign Ring
inset 0.05
material assign Sign
inset 0.130
material assign Ring
mode object
select Sack
active Sack
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < -0.21"
delete only-faces
mode object
select all
shade flat
inspect stats
export chute.glb
